test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

My sisters __wished me good luck__ before I went on the stage to sing.

options.text: Told me to sit on the fence
Told me to break a leg
Told me to break the ice
Told me to break an arm

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"break a leg"** means to wish someone good luck, especially before a performance. (शुभकामनाएँ देना)

 
 
• **Example: **Before the play started, all the actors told each other to "break a leg".
 
 
 
• **"Good luck"** is an expression used to wish someone success. (शुभकामनाएं)
 
 
• **Example: **My friends wished me good luck before my exam.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Told me to sit on the fence** (फैसला न कर पाना): To be undecided or not to take sides in a dispute.

 
 
• **Example:** He tends to sit on the fence whenever there is a debate.
 
 
 
• **Told me to break the ice** (बातचीत शुरू करना): To initiate conversation in a social setting.
 
 
• **Example:** He tried to break the ice at the party by telling a joke.
 
 
 
• **Told me to break an arm** (कोई अर्थ नहीं): This is not a commonly used phrase and does not make sense in this context.
